C1.worst_defect: On the phone the home header shows only the logo, a search icon and an unlabelled chevron, so Docs, Live demo and Quick start are hidden until the hero buttons; there is also no line saying who it is not for (for example 'not a Shopify POS / Square replacement with hardware').

C2.worst_defect: The hero sells an 'open-source till', but self-hosting needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' with no word that this is a paid third-party licence or what it costs, and nothing says who runs app.vendurepos.com, the only alternative. Add the unfixed role defect: the changelog says 'Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder', and the last plugin release is 2026-10-06.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' bullet 5; limitations.desktop.01 bullet 3; changelog.desktop.01 0.2.0 last bullet

C3.worst_defect: Step 5 (CORS) adds a stray legacy note, 'A store that already allows https://vendurepos.vercel.app keeps it for as long as anyone still opens the POS at that address', which a new installer cannot act on. Device-key users must also hand-patch ReadOrder into the role the plugin's own 'New POS till key' button creates.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.02 / quick-start.phone.05; quick-start 'Optional: a device key for each till'

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for the plugin's authors, not for users: 'GET /tally/v1/info advertises order.create 1–5 (ADR 0005)', 'lineTax: { none: true, classes: true }'. The quick-start troubleshoot line 'The store must advertise order.create v4 and register v1' uses the same internal protocol words without explaining them.

C5.worst_defect: 'What it does today' is ten identical grey text cards in a 2-column grid with no icon, image or visual weighting, so the two proven claims (offline, sale lands once) look no different from 'Park a sale'.

C6.worst_defect: Headings carrying inline code wrap to three lines on 390 px, for example '2. Add TallyPosPlugin to your existing Vendure config', which pushes the step body far down; otherwise code and tables reflow cleanly.

C7.worst_defect: The quick start's Lighthouse run still flags 'largest-contentful-paint (0.88): 2.6 s' and render-blocking requests. The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD has no softwareVersion, although the site leads with 'plugin 0.3.0'.

overall_worst.defect: A buyer cannot judge lock-in. The site calls VendurePOS an open-source, MIT-licensed till, yet the only way to run it without a paid third-party RxDB Premium licence (price and terms not stated) is app.vendurepos.com, and no page says who operates that host or what happens if it stops.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start'; limitations.desktop.01; connect-a-till.desktop.01 'The till's source is MIT-licensed…'
overall_worst.fix: Next to the RXDB_PREMIUM line, say plainly that RxDB Premium is a paid commercial licence and link its pricing. Add one sentence naming who runs app.vendurepos.com and its continuity promise, for example 'static files, no server-side data; you can self-host the same build'.
